settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Changes are saved instantly. Audio options apply the next time you start streaming.
settings.language.title: Display language
settings.general.startWithWindows.title: Start with Windows
settings.general.startWithWindows.hint: Opens minimized to the tray when you sign in
settings.general.closeAction.title: When closing the main window
settings.general.closeAction.hint: Hiding the window never stops streaming
settings.general.resume.title: Resume streaming on launch
settings.general.resume.hint: If it was streaming when closed. Waits up to 5 min for Wi-Fi and the Sonos.
settings.audio.muteLocal.title: Mute PC speakers while streaming
settings.audio.muteLocal.hint: In “One app”, only that app stops playing on the PC (Windows sends it to an output nobody hears); other apps and games keep their sound and the Sonos still receives it. If this PC has no such output, the app's output is muted instead. Restored when you stop, when you quit, and even after an unexpected shutdown.
settings.audio.prebuffer.title: Dropout buffer
settings.audio.prebuffer.hint: The Sonos receives this much audio up front and plays with that delay, riding out short Wi-Fi hiccups. More buffer = more stable, more delay.
settings.audio.fullLevel.title: Full level
settings.audio.fullLevel.hint: Only in “Whole PC”, where Windows applies its volume to the captured audio: raises the Windows volume to 100% while the PC is muted. Requires “Mute the PC”.
settings.mini.show.title: Show the mini player
settings.mini.show.hint: Floating capsule with volume, pause and source. Hiding it doesn't stop the audio
settings.mini.topmost.title: Always on top
settings.mini.topmost.hint: Stays above other windows; never takes keyboard focus (won't interrupt games)
settings.mini.rememberPosition.title: Remember its position
settings.mini.rememberPosition.hint: Reappears where you left it, always within the screen
settings.mini.minimizeToMini.title: Show the mini player when minimizing
settings.mini.minimizeToMini.hint: The main window hides and the capsule stays
settings.mini.minimizeToMini.a11y: Show the mini player when minimizing
settings.mini.dimWhenIdle.title: Dim when not in use
settings.mini.dimWhenIdle.hint: Slightly lowers the opacity when the mouse isn't over it
settings.mini.hotkeys.title: Global keyboard shortcuts
settings.diagnostics.logs.title: Streaming logs
settings.backup.hint: Date-stamped project backups, verified with SHA-256. They are never overwritten or deleted; restoring first backs up the current state.
settings.about.description: Streams your PC's audio to a Sonos speaker over the local network (UPnP + HTTP). All processing is local: no audio or data is sent to the internet and no personal information is collected.
settings.about.disclaimer: Personal project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Sonos, Inc. “Sonos” is a trademark of its owner.
settings.general.sounds.title: Interface sounds
settings.general.sounds.hint: Gentle confirmations when changing settings. Silent while streaming.
